meta.name: river-channel-development
meta.description: Use when planning river navigation routes or developing drainage channels. Maps nine major river systems from source to terminus, guides dredging, embankment construction, and integration into tribute transportation networks.

copy.tagline: 规划河流航道与排水渠网
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要规划内河航道或设计排水系统。
copy.tagline_en: Plan river navigation routes and drainage channels.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to plan inland waterways or design drainage systems.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据九大河流系统（如弱水、黑水、河等）规划航行路线或开发排水渠道。它会指导识别源头、绘制路径、疏浚阻塞段、建设堤防，并连接贡赋运输网络。
howto.when: 当用户要求规划河流航行路线或开发排水渠道时触发。

say.note: Claude 会开始识别源头并绘制路径。
Claude 将指导疏浚和堤防建设。

say.text: 连接河系统到贡赋运输网络。
say.note: Claude 会整合河与其他水道。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can plan navigation routes or develop drainage channels based on nine major river systems (e.g., Ruoshui, Heishui, He). It guides source identification, course mapping, dredging, embankment construction, and integration into tribute transportation networks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to plan river navigation routes or develop drainage channels.

say_en.text: Plan a navigation route on the Ruoshui River.
say_en.note: Claude starts by locating the source and mapping the course.

say_en.text: Develop drainage channels for the Heishui River.
say_en.note: Claude guides dredging and embankment building.

say_en.text: Connect the He River system to the tribute transport network.
say_en.note: Claude integrates the river with other waterways.
